newsitem.title: FRANCE: FIGURE SKATING-KWAN WINS BUT IS UNHAPPY WITH NEW PROGRAMME.
newsitem.headline: FIGURE SKATING-KWAN WINS BUT IS UNHAPPY WITH NEW PROGRAMME.

text.p: World champion Michelle Kwan criticised her own performance after winning the women's title at the Lalique Trophy grand prix on Saturday.
The 16-year-old American finished in front of Russia's Maria Butirskaya and compatriot Tara Lipinski in the meeting at Bercy, venue for the European championships.
"My programme was not good and I'm not very happy with it. I messed up the end and was slightly off balance," Kwan said.
"Sometimes you don't feel right during the jumps but you can't do anything about it.
"But I love my new music. It enhances my feelings and how I express them, which is what I wanted to show the crowd."
European champions Oksana Kazakova and Arthur Dmitriev of Russia won the pairs final, hauling themselves up from third after the short programme.
A perfect performance in the free programme saw them overtake Americans Jenni Menno and Todd Sand, bronze medal winners at the last world championships.
